name: io.github.freema/mcp-jira-stdio
description: MCP server for Jira Cloud — issues, search, comments, attachments, transitions.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Email of the Jira account the API token belongs to

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Jira API token (id.atlassian.com > Security > API tokens)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_REDACT_SENSITIVE
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to redact sensitive values from logs

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn or error (default: info)
